coordinateFrame.origin: Deposited STL origin, unchanged; anatomical origin unverified

axes.x: deposited STL x; anatomical direction unverified
axes.y: deposited STL y; anatomical direction unverified

source.title: 3D mouse embryo model: EMA147, Stage TS23, Age E15.0 (est)
source.attribution: Ruffins S, Jacobs R, Armit C, Burton N, Hill B and Baldock R, 2017, University of Edinburgh, doi:10.7488/ds/2167, CC BY 4.0. Native-coordinate PLY adaptation by Qasim Hussain for MouseBio_3D.
modifications: Exact-position indexing within each source surface
Float32 native-coordinate storage without a physical scale conversion
Generated area-weighted vertex normals for display
Original source triangles, winding and topology defects retained

specimen.description: Source-declared C57BL6 mouse model at Theiler stage TS23. Age claims conflict; sex and mass are not declared.

limitations: Equal inventory counts do not establish equal identities. File order is not a label-volume mapping.
Colours transfer only for exact source EMAPA identifiers; no anatomical substitutions are made.

processing.vertexReuse: Only exactly equal positions within one source surface share an index.
processing.normalProcessing: Area-weighted unit vertex normals for display; original STL facet normals are not stored in the PLY.
processing.normalCancellationFallback: First incident nonzero triangle normal in original source order.

limitations: Deposited STL units are unknown. Image voxel spacing is not a surface scale; calibrated measurements are unavailable.
Source ages E15.0 estimated, 15 dpc and 14.5 dpc remain unresolved; TS23 is consistently declared.
The anatomy index and STL inventory share only 68 of 76 EMAPA identifiers. No mapping by file order or substituted anatomy is made.
The unannotated reference.stl surface has no asserted anatomical identity. Its low opacity is a display setting.
Open/nonmanifold edges, winding conflicts and noncyclic vertex links are retained. Numerical checks do not establish anatomical accuracy.
The embryonic source is separate from adult references. No physiological validation, adult anatomy or accepted registration is inferred.
Anatomical directions, physical calibration and unreviewed system categories remain unavailable. Magnification adds no biological detail.
